$comment: Workspace tool paths + settings. COPY to tools.json (gitignored) and fill in for your machine. Populate/refresh automatically with the `modlist-install` skill, or edit by hand. Use forward slashes; they work fine in PowerShell.
_modlistRoot_help: Root of the installed Wabbajack modlist (the MO2 instance: contains ModOrganizer.exe, mods/, profiles/, tools/). Leave blank if you are not using a modlist and set the explicit tool paths below instead.
_gameRoot_help: Skyrim SE game folder. With a Wabbajack list this is usually <modlistRoot>/Stock Game (or 'Game Root' / 'Stock Game Folder'), a self-contained copy so the modlist never touches your Steam install.
_gameSourceScripts_help: Vanilla Papyrus .psc imports + TESV_Papyrus_Flags.flg. Extract <gameDataDir>/Scripts.zip here once if the folder is missing.
_sseedit_help: SSEEdit.exe (xEdit), for manual conflict/error review. Reference key; no skill wraps it. Wabbajack dev lists ship it under <modlistRoot>/tools/xEdit/.
_sseeditQuickAutoClean_help: SSEEditQuickAutoClean.exe — headless master cleaner (strips ITMs/UDRs/deleted refs). Same xEdit folder. Reference key; no skill wraps it.
_xeditScriptsDir_help: xEdit 'Edit Scripts' folder (contains 'Check for Errors.pas' etc.) — pass to SSEEdit -script when running it by hand. Reference key; no skill wraps it.
_bsarch_help: BSArch64.exe — CLI BSA/BA2 packer (bundled in xEdit's folder). Reference key; no skill wraps it yet.
_synthesis_help: Synthesis.exe — Mutagen patcher pipeline runner. Reference key; no skill wraps it yet.
_resaver_help: ReSaver.exe (Fallrim Tools) — savegame script cleaner (GUI-primary). Reference key; no skill wraps it yet.
_cao_help: Cathedral Assets Optimizer .exe — mesh/texture optimization. Reference key; no skill wraps it yet.
_nifskope_help: NifSkope.exe — .nif mesh viewer/editor. Reference key; no skill wraps it yet.
_octagon_help: Octagon.exe — BSA/texture GUI tool. Reference key; no skill wraps it yet.
_bae_help: bae.exe (Beth Archive Extract) — alternate .bsa/.ba2 extractor STD ships instead of BSA Browser. Reference key; `bsa-extract` uses `bsab`.
_modlistsRoot_help: Parent folder of MO2 instances you install built mods into for testing (e.g. STD, LoreRim, Baseline). May be the same as modlistRoot's parent.
_modsDir_help: The MO2 'mods' folder the `mod-deploy` skill copies dist/<ModName>/ into, e.g. C:/modding/modlists/STD/mods. Set this rather than letting anything search for it.
_deployModName_help: EXACT folder name to create under modsDir, e.g. 'My-Mod-Name'. Frequently differs from the .esp name (spaces/dashes/case). A mismatch here is the #1 cause of 'my change never showed up in-game' - MO2 simply doesn't see the folder and the game runs fine without it.
_importDirs_help: Extra Papyrus Source/Scripts dirs (SKSE, SkyUI, MCM, other mods) appended to the compiler -i path. Add as you discover them.
